notes: A person can now hold several jobs at once. Organizations and roles moved into a Positions list on each person, so someone who is a CEO at one company and a CTO at another keeps both, each marked current or past. Existing people keep their stored job as a current position, and older backups restore the same way. The assistant also no longer discards a whole proposal when it just wants to explain how it handled something; those notes now appear on the card instead.
